title: Nature Scientific Reports 2025 Stacked Ensemble — CPU-actionable: AdaBoost + NaiveBayes + KNN

source.paper: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis

source_2.paper: Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes: NBA and WNBA Leagues
source_2.note: confirms ensemble diversity benefit; CNN Brier 0.221 (similar to our fleet best 0.22012)

source_3.note: flagged for investigation — content not yet analyzed, may contain feature engineering insights

key_findings: PMC12357926 stacked ensemble: AdaBoost, NaiveBayes, KNN, XGBoost, Decision Tree, MLP base learners with LR meta-learner
AdaBoost is validated as one of strongest NBA base learners — boosted stumps, low bias, orthogonal inductive bias to XGB/LGB
GaussianNB provides population-level diversity via independence assumption; fast CPU eval <0.1s
KNN (5-15 neighbors) captures local matchup similarity and back-to-back schedule effects
LR meta-learner re-confirms LR standalone value (already validated by IEEE 11030489, MDPI 17/1/56)
MDPI 2079-3197/13/10/230: CNN achieved Brier 0.221 on NBA — equivalent to our CPU fleet best 0.22012

cpu_actionable.rule_8_constraint: CPU-only islands. No neural models (MLP, CNN excluded). No stacking meta-learner (Rule#8 violation). All additions must be standalone classifiers in MODEL_TYPES.

additions.cpu_speed: fast (~2-5s/eval at 7213 features with feature selection gate)
additions.diversity_value: boosting inductive bias orthogonal to bagging (RF/ET) and gradient boosting (XGB/LGB); strong NBA validated base learner
feature independence assumption creates strong divergent diversity signal; essentially free compute

additions.cpu_speed: moderate — O(N*d) at inference, may be slow with 7213 features; requires feature selection gate of ~100 features
additions.diversity_value: local similarity captures back-to-back fatigue, historical matchup patterns
additions.caveat: only add after LR+AdaBoost validated; high feature-count inference cost is a concern

implementation_sequence: 2. AdaBoost after LR validated per island (vm-add-adaboost-naive-bayes-model-pool priority-56)
3. NaïveBayes alongside AdaBoost as free diversity add
4. KNN only after AdaBoost confirmed and feature selection gate verified

cross_project_scope.note: Apply to NBA first (larger eval dataset, faster feedback). Port to POL after NBA validation.

expected_impact: AdaBoost in GA pool adds boosting diversity. GA fitness pressure keeps/discards via Brier. If AdaBoost reaches LR territory (~0.221), fleet best improves. NaïveBayes adds diversity signal at zero cost. Combined: wider model selection in GA → higher probability of evolutionary breakthrough past current fleet best 0.22012.
